definitions.explanation: A person who has completed their studies and graduated from a school, university, or other educational institution.

examples.japanese: {卒業生|そつぎょうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}した→挨拶する：01797_aisatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I gave a speech as the representative of the graduates.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{卒業生|そつぎょうせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{各分野|かくぶんや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}している→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: Graduates of this university are active in various fields.

examples.japanese: {卒業生|そつぎょうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{母校|ぼこう}→母校：14958_bokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まって→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦{同窓会|どうそうかい}→同窓会：15875_dousoukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}き→開く：01979_hiraku⟧、⟦{懐|なつ}かしい→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}り{合|あ}った→語り合う：03045_katariau⟧。
examples.english: Graduates gathered at their alma mater for a reunion and shared fond memories.

notes:
USAGE:
{卒業生|そつぎょうせい} is a compound of ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧ (graduation) and {生|せい} (student/person). It refers to someone who has already graduated, in contrast to ⟦{在校生|ざいこうせい}→在校生：17792_zaikousei⟧ (current students).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {卒業生|そつぎょうせい}⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧ (representative of the graduating class)
- {卒業生|そつぎょうせい}⟦{一同|いちどう}→一同：08918_ichidou⟧ (all graduates)
- ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{卒業生|そつぎょうせい} (famous alumni)
- {卒業生|そつぎょうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}り{出|だ}す→送り出す：06085_okuridasu⟧ (to send off graduates)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {卒業生|そつぎょうせい}: graduate, alumnus (general)
- OB/OG: old boy / old girl (informal Japanese abbreviations for alumni)
- ⟦{同窓生|どうそうせい}→同窓生：21773_dousousei⟧: fellow alumni (emphasizes shared school connection)
